presentation.summary: Fetch series, season, episode, and artwork metadata from TheTVDB.
presentation.description_markdown: Provides television metadata for series, seasons, and episodes, plus image resolution for TVDB artwork stored by Prairie. It complements other providers when a library relies on TVDB identities or ordering.
presentation.setup_markdown:
TVDB Metadata is installed as a default Prairie plugin. Add or enable **TVDB** in a television library's metadata provider chain.

Operators must configure a **TVDB API key** for the plugin to authenticate with TheTVDB.

capabilities.description: Resolves tvdb:// image paths to TheTVDB image URLs.

global_config_schema.title: TVDB API key
global_config_schema.description: TheTVDB v4 API key used for authenticated requests.

global_config_schema.title: Metadata Proxy
global_config_schema.description: Route TVDB requests through a TVDB-compatible metadata proxy instead of calling TVDB directly. A caching proxy lets many installations share one set of upstream requests, so scans hit TVDB far less often. Prairie does not operate a shared proxy; point this at one you run or trust. Turn it off to call TVDB directly.

fields.label: Use metadata proxy
fields.description: When on, this plugin sends TVDB requests to the proxy URL below instead of api4.thetvdb.com.

fields.label: Proxy URL
fields.description: Base URL of the metadata proxy, for example https://metadata.example.org. Leave blank to call TVDB directly.
